title: BiFair: A Fairness-aware Training Framework for LLM-enhanced Recommender Systems via Bi-level Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping items based on interaction counts (e.g., top 10% popular items vs. the remaining 90%) and measuring recommendation utility dispersion using Coefficient of Variation (CV@K) and worst-case performance (MIN@K) across these popularity groups.

Grouping items directly based on their metadata genres and evaluating recommendation fairness by calculating the utility dispersion (CV@K) and the average utility of the bottom 25% worst-performing genre groups (MIN@K).
